name: keycloak_no_successful_logins
title: Keycloak no successful logins
description: No successful logins in realm for the last 15 minutes.

source.upstream_query: sum by (realm) (rate(keycloak_logins_total[15m])) == 0 and (sum by (realm) (rate(keycloak_logins_total[15m])) + sum by (realm) (rate(keycloak_failed_login_attempts_total[15m]))) > 0
source.upstream_description: No successful logins in realm {{ $labels.realm }} for the last 15 minutes.
source.query_normalized: The upstream threshold could not be lifted out of the expression (its outermost operator is and/or/unless, or it compares against another series), so the expression is normalised to 1 per matching series and the alert fires on any match. The observed value in the notification is therefore always 1.

notes: Only fires when login attempts exist but none succeed — may indicate an authentication outage.
